messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Change the video's camera setup to a full-body shot from a front three-quarter angle. Change only the camera setup. Preserve the person's appearance, expression, and action, along with the existing scene. Use the provided reference image to determine the viewing direction, subject placement, and framing at the start of the edited video. Follow the camera setup and movement described above, and preserve the timing and progression of the action in the source video.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: I'd like to change the video's camera setup to a full-body shot from a front three-quarter angle. Change only the camera setup. Preserve the person's appearance, expression, and action, along with the existing scene. Use the provided reference image to determine the viewing direction, subject placement, and framing at the start of the edited video. Follow the camera setup and movement described above, and preserve the timing and progression of the action in the source video.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"The woman stands with her back to the camera, then turns to her right and finally faces the camera with her hands on her hips.","camera":"A static, eye-level full shot from a distance.","clothing":"A short, blue and white patterned dress with cold-shoulder cutouts and orange slip-on sneakers.","hair_color":"White.","hairstyle":"Short, curly hair in a bob cut.","identity":"A 3D-rendered woman with a slim build, light brown skin, and a neutral facial expression.","scene":"An outdoor amusement park at dusk, featuring a large swing ride on the left and a carousel structure on the right."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The output is a full-body shot from a new amusement-park viewpoint with a swing ride on the left and a carousel on the right. The woman remains in the same blue-and-white dress and orange shoes, and she turns from a rear-facing pose to face the camera with hands on hips. The opening framing matches the reference image closely.
arguments.requested_change: Change only the camera to a full-body front three-quarter shot, using the reference for initial viewing direction, subject placement, and framing while preserving the person, action, scene, and timing.
uncertain: Whether the reference was intended to show the same location or only the desired camera angle and framing.
unexpected_changes: The background scene was changed from the source daytime fairground with a striped tent and wooden buildings to a dusk amusement park with a large swing ride and carousel.
The person's action was altered: the source included raising an arm to the head and a different turning sequence, while the output shows a simpler turn and hands-on-hips pose.
The lighting changed from bright daylight to warm dusk lighting.
